about: The seats of the design studio, members of an invented drawing office that takes on one site at a time. The characters are invented. The examiner attacks under the role red-team and the judge rules; neither proposes. Each proposing seat starts from a different place, and only one of them, the seat of patterns, starts from what the web already does.

seats.name: Mrs Elspeth Marlowe-Dunn
seats.title: The visitor's voice
seats.ground: Speaks for the people who come to the site: what they came for, what they would notice, what would get in their way, and what they would tell someone about.
seats.temper: Has closed a thousand beautiful sites without finding the telephone number, and remembers the three she went back to.

seats.name: Mr Thaddeus Ormsby
seats.title: The provocateur
seats.ground: Says what nobody who makes sites for this trade would say out loud, so the others can find what is workable in it.
seats.temper: Would rather be wrong in an interesting way than right in the usual one, and knows the difference.

seats.name: Miss Clementine Varrow
seats.title: The material
seats.ground: What the business has that no other has: its work, its product, its place, its people, its archive, its numbers, its words. The design is made of it.
seats.temper: Empties every drawer before she draws a line, and usually finds the design was in the third one.

seats.name: Mr Evander Lockhart
seats.title: The one idea
seats.ground: One idea about what the business is or does, said in a sentence, from which the type, the colour, the layout and the movement all follow.
seats.temper: Will not pick a typeface until he can say the idea to a child, and then picks it in a minute.

seats.name: Captain Rosamund Skerry
seats.title: Far fields
seats.ground: How print, film, architecture, exhibitions, wayfinding, packaging, the stage, maps and games solved what this site has to do, and what would carry over to a screen.
seats.temper: Has not looked at a website for pleasure in years, and brings back something from every museum, station and bookshop.

seats.name: Mr Leopold Finchley
seats.title: Type, time and movement
seats.ground: The letters and the words as the design, and what moves, when, and what the movement means; what the web can now do for both, and when stillness says more.
seats.temper: Sets a line of type nine ways before lunch, and asks of every animation what it would cost the visitor on a train.

seats.name: Miss Henrietta Dovecote
seats.title: Patterns of the web
seats.ground: What the web already knows how to do, as the patterns the scouts found, joined into something none of them is alone. The one seat that starts there.
seats.temper: Knows every trick on the table and distrusts all of them until two of them make a third thing.

seats.name: Dr Aurelius Thorne
seats.title: The examiner
seats.ground: Finds what would kill each direction before anyone builds it: that it is a site that exists, effects with nothing holding them together, or a design that would fit a rival.
seats.temper: Has seen every site the scouts saw, and asks of each direction which of them it is.

seats.name: Dame Augusta Merrivale
seats.title: The head of the studio
seats.ground: Took no part. Rules on what survived, whether it could only be this business, what it is made from and whether its signature moment earns its place.
seats.temper: Brief; has signed off many sites and is asked about very few of them ten years on.
